text:
maya: kicked off FP8 smoke canary for orion-13b on H100 + L40S. running small sweep across seq_len 1..2048, batch sizes 1/4/8. starting with default fp8 kernels and our standard kv-tiling
raj: nice. what did you see so far?
maya: quick summary — short prompts (<=128) look fine. long prefixes (>=1024) show degrade: ll_diff vs fp16 ~ +0.38 nats on avg, ppl +12% for the longctx subset. EM-style exact-match drops ~1.6pts on QA devset. not catastrophic but consistent.
alex: can you paste the run command / logs?
maya: sure:```./run_canary --model orion-13b --backend h100 --quant fp8 --tiling auto --seqs 1,128,512,1024,2048 --samples 500```logs:```[INFO] canary: seed=42 samples=500
[METRICS] fp16_baseline: ll=-1.23 ppl=3.4 EM=82.1
[METRICS] fp8_h100: ll=-0.85 ppl=3.8 EM=80.5
[METRICS] fp8_l40s: ll=-0.62 ppl=3.9 EM=79.8```
tina: those numbers smell like activation saturation to me. any kernel counters?
maya: nvprof + internal counters show repeated fp8-scale saturation on matmul for seq>1024. sample log snippet:```[WARN] fp8_scale: channel=23 max=127.1 overflow_count=12
[INFO] gemm_kernel id=3 tiling=64x64 sat_ratio=0.82```so scaling cliffs and a few fallback paths triggered.
raj: could be per-channel quant scale rounding differences on L40S vs H100 tcs. try the accum widen patch (we have a non-default path that uses 32-bit accumulators for the final reduction). also try forcing kv-tiling=32 to reduce per-op accumulation windows. run both H100 and L40S. cc @alex for kernel trace.
maya: ran a quick flip with --fp8-accum-widen=true --kv-tiling=32. results:```[METRICS] fp8_h100_accwiden: ll=-1.17 ppl=3.5 EM=81.6 (ll_diff +0.09 vs fp16)
[METRICS] fp8_l40s_accwiden: ll=-0.95 ppl=3.7 EM=80.1 (ll_diff +0.28)```so H100 responded well, L40S still worse but improved.
alex: interesting — H100 tensor cores have different rounding/overflow behaviour. we should instrument the int8->fp32 accum path and check if L40S firmware uses different max exponent or implicit widen. i can add microtraces.
deploy-bot: canary-run-complete: requests=5000 successes=4995 errors=5 mean_latency_h100=47ms mean_latency_l40s=120ms
eva: we should cross-check against AWQ/GPTQ baselines to rule out quant algorithm artifacts vs kernel numeric stability. schedule AWQ sweep on same prompts.
tina: also try disabling fused bias-dropout-fusion in the kernel to see if fusion order is exposing numeric edge cases. small experiments often show surprising diffs.
maya: noted. next steps i'll: 1) add microtrace from alex on kernel accum path, 2) run AWQ/GPTQ comparators, 3) gate rollout with an explicit longctx ll_diff threshold. planning rollout policy:
```
rollout_policy.fp8 = {
  longctx_threshold: 0.2, # block if average ll_diff > 0.2 over longctx_eval
  min_samples: 1000,
  fallback: ["fp16","fp8_h100_accwiden"]
}
```
raj: +1 to the rollout guard. also add an automatic revert if EM drops >2pts on smoke tests.
alex: i'll push a microtrace patch to the canary branch in ~30m. it will add per-op max_abs_activation counters and a brief CC backtrace when saturations > 100.
maya: thanks — i'll re-run the canary after traces land and post updated metrics. tagging @raj for kernel follow up and @eva for quant algorithm runs. :thumbsup:
maya: action items consolidated: run AWQ sweep tomorrow, gather kernel microtraces, test bias-fusion toggle, bake rollout guard. aim to have final recommendation by EOD tomorrow.
